# PART 3 – Reproduction and exploration {#part-3-reproduction-and-exploration .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. This is the coding-heavy part, and the centre of the day. You reproduce the value that Multi100 recorded for one of the five analysts, from the very file that the analysts received, and then you ask the question that a reproduction does not answer by itself: is the number right? That question takes most of the first hour, and I will not give you the answer before you have found it. Then we reproduce the published coefficient itself, from the survey files, and work out what it means. In the last stretch we open the menu of choices that any analyst of this claim faces, and you work the menu yourself, one decision at a time.
:::
